label: Bacteria to AI
summary: Bacteria to AI is a book attributed to N. Katherine Hayles that Maaike is in the process of reading. It is characterised as slow reading material and demonstrates the concept of nonconscious cognition. A reading log exists in Maaike's digital garden as both a record of engagement and a self-imposed reminder to actually follow through with reading it.
open_questions: What does Maaike make of nonconscious cognition as Hayles develops it across the book?
Will the reading log develop into sustained notes or remain a placeholder?
